name: print-social-experimental-poster-wall-in-monochrome-and-red
title: Eight experimental posters: distressed type, cut-out figures, red thread and a Windows-like sky
whatItIs: A white slide titled 'SOME OF MY POSTERS' with two rows of four portrait posters: crowds of figures, a foot with red lines, an arm with 'The elephant is pushing on my chest', 'SORRY' in heavy type over a crying eye, a blue pattern 'Sail me to the moon', a circular red-lined collage, a blue sky with clouds, and a face wrapped in red snakes.
whatItMeans: Moody and expressive; most posters are monochrome with one red or blue accent.
techniques: Limit posters to black and white with a single accent.
Distress and crop type to match emotion.
Use one red drawn line across images.
Show a set in an aligned grid.

vocabulary.definition: Lettering with worn or rough texture.
A single coloured line across a mono image.
A set of posters shown together.
A close crop chosen for feeling.
